title: On Rubio de Francia's maximal theorem
summary: In his influential 1986 paper, Rubio de Francia established $L^p$ bounds for the maximal function generated by dilations of measures $μ$ whose Fourier transforms $\widehatμ$ satisfy specific decay condition. In the present work, we obtain results that complement his work in several directions. In particular, we obtain restricted weak-type endpoint bound on the maximal function and $L^p$--$L^q$ bounds on its local variant.
